svg.desc: A seven-step pipeline: text, subword tokens, ids with an attention mask, token plus position embeddings, a six-layer encoder, hidden states of shape batch by tokens by 768, and mask-aware mean pooling to one 768-dimensional vector per sentence.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
